scripts.setup: npm run build -w @testplace/shared && npm run generate -w @testplace/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @testplace/shared && npm run build -w @testplace/api && npm run build -w @testplace/web
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/web/src packages/shared/src e2e
scripts.test:int: npm run setup && npm run test:int -w @testplace/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run setup && npm run start:dev -w @testplace/api
